tasks.title: Name the global demand surface Tasks
tasks.objective: Replace the visible Board surface name with Tasks at every primary navigation and title entry.
tasks.outcome: The global switch, breadcrumb, and demand workspace toolbar consistently say Tasks, while persisted Demand selection remains unchanged.
acceptance: The three-item main switch reads Focus, Workspaces, Tasks and preserves the existing board route identity.
The global demand surface breadcrumb and toolbar read Tasks; no product-visible primary Board title remains.
Clicking Tasks still opens the existing Demand work area and retains the selected Demand across cross-surface navigation.

verification.proves: visible navigation name and preserved demand workspace
